policies.title: Finnish ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's Special Branch makes tourists from European countries eligible to obtain a visa on arrival at Dhaka; this includes Finnish ordinary-passport holders.
conditions: This is the named European-country tourist category for a single-entry arrival visa at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, for a maximum of 30 days.

Bangladesh says the immigration officer issues the visa after reviewing compliance; required travel documents, funds and final admission remain separate. Work, residence, special passports and third-country-document routes are excluded.

policies.title: Finnish ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board lists Finland as eligible for a visa obtained on arrival.
conditions: The named Finland table entry says the visa is obtained on arrival and gives a 40 JOD fee; it is not reclassified as eVisa merely because Jordan also offers an electronic service.
Entry point, passport validity, onward travel, work, residence, special-passport, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.

policies.title: Finnish ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's official consular schedule expressly lists Finland among nationalities that do not need a visa for a short visitor stay.
conditions: The official schedule gives a maximum stay of three months. It is a Finland-specific named waiver, not an inference from Panama's separate third-country visa or residence exemption.
Passport validity, funds, return travel, work, residence, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate.
